old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-mpq0","title":"Provision persistence and integrity hooks can reenter verifier and regress rollback state","description":"Fresh final timing robustness/security review: ProvisionVerifier.install and clear invoke external verify_integrity, persist_rollback_state, and persist_clear callbacks while holding a threading.RLock, which explicitly permits same-thread reentry. A one-shot persist hook can recursively install a higher version; after the inner commit returns, the outer lower-version install resumes and overwrites __rollback/__current, regressing the in-memory floor. Clear/install cross-reentry can likewise violate generation/current/cleared atomicity. Add an explicit non-reentrant transition guard covering verify/persist/commit/clear (or a transaction design with post-callback generation revalidation), fail closed on callback reentry without partial state mutation, and test v2 outer→v3 inner, install→clear, clear→install, callback exceptions, and concurrent non-reentrant callers.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T08:53:15.899334Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T08:53:15.899334Z"}
